Ch136 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 136)

Subject: graph theory | ID: 35991

Statement

Let Omega be a bounded domain with smooth boundary. Every uniform solution of the elliptic equation in Omega extends smoothly to the closure.

Proof

Step 1. By the semisimple spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01360011} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the semisimple spectral family.

Step 2. By the rational spectral theorem, we decompose \(A_{01360012} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the rational spectral family.

Step 3. Applying the torsion-free interpolation theorem to \(S_{01360013}\), we obtain the norm bound in the mixed Lebesgue scale for the appropriate exponents.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through analytic approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
